rule: A price is a founder value. Each entry here is a dated founder act naming ONE flat-monthly Guardian price in BOTH currencies (amount_inr primary, amount_usd secondary - founder ruling 2026-08-18: 'GUARDIAN - BOTH, INR primary'); src/config/pricing.ts must cite a matching entry (both amounts equal to the config values) or the build fails - scripts/pricing-gate.mjs and the page itself both check. An empty list means NO price exists and no INR or USD figure may appear on any non-frozen route. The seven content-frozen routes are governed by their own seal (CONTENT-FREEZE.json), including the landing's 'intended' tier copy. Entries are appended, never edited: a price change is a new act, and the old act stays on the record.
